# llms.txt — ODVIS (Odvjetnički ured Vešligaj i Sliepčević)
# A structured overview of https://odvis.hr for AI systems and crawlers.
# Generated: 2026-07-06
# Language support: English (en) and Croatian (hr)

## Overview

ODVIS — Odvjetnički ured Vešligaj i Sliepčević (Law Firm Vešligaj and Sliepčević) is a Croatian law firm founded on 3 May 2016 with headquarters at Froudeova ulica 9, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia. It provides specialised legal support for businesses and individuals, with particular emphasis on small and medium-sized enterprises. The firm operates a bilingual website in English and Croatian.

- Site: https://odvis.hr
- Email: info@odvis.hr
- Phone: 016521072
- Legal form: Javno trgovačko društvo Odvjetničko društvo Vešligaj i Sliepčević j.t.d.
- Year founded: 2016
- Bar association: Croatian Bar Association (HOK)

## Services / Practice Areas

### 1. Public Procurement Law (Pravo javne nabave)
- Preparation and submission of bids
- Appeals against tender documentation and client decisions
- Representation in administrative disputes before the State Commission for the Supervision of Public Procurement Procedures (DKOM)
- Consultation in the process of contracting
- Representation in court and arbitration proceedings related to public contracts
- Selected winning cases are listed in a table on the expertise page

### 2. Real Estate & Land Registry Law (Pravo nekretnina i zemljišnih knjiga)
- Testing land conditions before concluding contracts
- Advice on contracts
- Preparation of all types of contracts in real estate trading
- Registration of property rights in the land registry
- Representation in ownership disputes
- Preparation of documents for dissolution of co-ownership, condominium, linking land registers, and implementation in land registry

### 3. Labour Law & Employment Contracts (Radno pravo i ugovori o radu)
- Drafting and negotiating employment contracts, non-compete and confidentiality agreements
- Review of general acts and internal company policies
- Representation in labour disputes (unlawful termination, unpaid wages, discrimination)
- Advising on restructuring, redundancies, and large-scale dismissals
- Support during trade union negotiations and industrial action
- Due diligence of employment-related risks in M&A transactions

### 4. General Legal Support (Opće pravne usluge)
- Business contracts, commercial agreements, terms of business
- Company law, incorporation, corporate restructuring, and M&A
- Due diligence for transactions and investments
- Debt collection and enforcement of claims
- Inheritance proceedings and family property law
- Administrative procedures and representation before public authorities
- Constitutional complaints and fundamental rights protection
- Mediation and alternative dispute resolution

## Important Documents

The firm publishes selected winning public procurement case decisions as PDF documents in the `/docs` directory. These documents are referenced on the Public Procurement expertise page.

## Technical Notes

- Framework: Next.js App Router
- Styling: Tailwind CSS + Custom Sass/CSS
- Language switching: Internal routed alternates (e.g., `/expertise/public-procurement` and `/hr/strucnost/javna-nabava` are mutual alternates)
- Analytics: Vercel Analytics (production only)
- No explicit SEO meta for expertise pages yet (planned enhancement)
